[[File:WattosIonizer-SWM80.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Watto's ionizer]]
An '''ionizer''' was a device used to stabilize [[ion field]]s for delicate maintenance.

==Description==
A tall, [[Metal/Legends|metallic]] cylinder, the ionizer rested on a base with a spinner motor inside, underneath a charge generator assembly. Above were two sets of ionizer arrays, one complex and one simple, the former including sweeper screens that stabilized local fields for delicate maintenance. The device's manual start knob was situated atop the device, beneath its tapered cap.<ref name="TPM VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Watto/Legends|Watto]] owned an ionizer on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM VD" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had ionizers in the storage bay of [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].<ref name="BF:ANT">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref>
